At Afxentis

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

Meze, dips and a sweet at the end

Afxentis Fish Restaurant is at Agkyras 118 in Limassol. Guests describe it as a restaurant in the old town, a little away from the tourist paths. Many reviews tell that the order comes with dips, olives, salad and bread, and that there is often fruit or a small dessert on the house at the end. Guests praise the fish meze, the grilled octopus, the sea bream and the swordfish, and many write about generous portions. According to Google there is outdoor seating, takeaway and delivery, reservations are accepted and recommended for dinner, and there is a free parking lot.

The Google listing has no website, only the phone number. Checked on 22 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.6 stars on average across 715 reviews. The reviews are quoted in their original English.

“This is by far one of the best fish restaurants in Cyprus. The fish is grilled to perfection the sides are immaculate and the service is excellent the waiters are super nice and accommodating. The atmosphere is also very good.”

Google review
“Never disappointed here! We visit Limassol 4-5 times a year and always try to find time to eat at Afxentis. The food is outstanding. Today we had seabass - beautifully cooked. Everything else (salad, potatoes, dips etc) was fresh, plentiful and tasty! Lovely staff; always so welcoming and friendly. Usually full of locals, which tells you all you need to know! Two minutes walk from the castle.”

Google review
“The most delicious fish meze in town! Everything is cooked perfectly and every dish has a unique flavor, finally, something that isn't just stir-fried! The prawns and sea bream are amazing. Plus, the service is excellent!”

Google review
